core_obligations: Reduce to the Artinian case: write the hull as the increasing union of its truncations and reduce to the corresponding statement for the quotients of the two local rings (proof lines 5521-5524)

Compare lengths: flatness makes the lengths over the source and over the target agree, and the cited length computation identifies the lengths of the two hulls, so the base changed hull and the hull of the target residue field have the same length (proof lines 5525-5532)
Produce and identify the map: the one dimensional socle of the base changed hull gives an injective map between the two hulls, and equality of lengths makes it an isomorphism (proof lines 5533-5542)
proof_roadmap: 写 E = ∪ E_n，化归到 A、B 都是 Artinian 局部环的情形。
由 pullback-module：length_A(A) = length_B(B)、length_A(E) = length_B(E ⊗_A B)；由 finite 引理 length_A(E) = length_A(A)、length_B(E') = length_B(B) ⇒ length_B(E ⊗_A B) = length_B(E')。
由平坦与 n = mB：dim_l((E ⊗_A B)[n]) = dim_κ(E[m]) = 1 ⇒ 由 torsion-submodule-sum-injective-hulls 得单射 E ⊗_A B → E'，长度相等 ⇒ 同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings with the maximal ideal of the target generated by that of the source, the base change of the injective hull of the source residue field is the injective hull of the target residue field (author lemma at source lines 5511-5518, label lemma-injective-hull-goes-up). The proof (source lines 5520-5543) reduces to the Artinian local case through the filtration of the hull by its truncations, compares the lengths of the base changed hull and of the target hull using flatness of the pullback of finite length modules and the cited length computation, and upgrades to an isomorphism the injective map produced by the one dimensional socle (proof lines 5533-5542). The length comparison is the substance. H3.
